properties.name: Interval
properties.usage: Set 1000 for a clock that updates every second.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Starts or stops the timer. Start() and Stop() set it too.
properties.usage: Start the timer when your form loads.
properties.expectedEffect: The timer begins to raise Tick.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: A free slot for attaching data to the timer.
properties.usage: Remember what the timer was started for.
properties.expectedEffect: The object is stored with the timer.

properties.name: WorkerReportsProgress
properties.description: Allows the work to report progress with ReportProgress.
properties.usage: Update a progress bar during long work.

properties.name: WorkerSupportsCancellation
properties.description: Allows CancelAsync to ask the work to stop.
properties.expectedEffect: CancelAsync no longer throws and sets CancellationPending.

properties.name: IsBusy
properties.description: True while the background operation is running.

properties.name: CancellationPending
properties.description: True after CancelAsync was called. Check it inside DoWork.

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: The icon in the notification area. Nothing is shown until you set one.
properties.usage: Show your application's icon in the tray.
properties.expectedEffect: The icon appears in the tray once Visible is true.

properties.name: Text
properties.acceptedValues: A short string (limited length: 63 characters in .NET Framework, 127 in modern .NET)
properties.description: The tip shown when the pointer is over the icon.

properties.name: Visible
properties.usage: Hide the icon when the program exits to avoid ghost icons.
properties.expectedEffect: The icon appears in the tray.

properties.name: ContextMenuStrip
properties.description: The menu shown when the user right-clicks the icon.
properties.expectedEffect: Right-clicking the icon opens the menu.

properties.name: BalloonTipTitle
properties.description: The title of the balloon shown by ShowBalloonTip.

properties.name: BalloonTipIcon
properties.usage: Mark a warning or an error.
properties.expectedEffect: An information icon is shown in the balloon.
